result.keywords: This survey examines adaptive GPU-oriented methods for large-scale graph analytics, focusing on how asynchronous execution, workload balancing, and memory-aware data layouts can improve performance on billion-edge graphs. It reviews the interaction between bulk-synchronous and asynchronous graph processing styles, discusses programming models for iterative graph algorithms on heterogeneous systems, and summarizes challenges in scheduling, convergence control, and bandwidth utilization. The article also highlights practical tradeoffs in parallel graph traversal, incremental computation, and real-time analytics on modern accelerators.
result.title: Adaptive GPU Parallelization for Large-Scale Graph Analytics: A Survey
